text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak discusses with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat latest developments on the Palestinian track. After the Cairo airport talks, Foreign Minister Amr Moussa says that Hebron agreement must be fulfilled.
- Moussa says after submitting a report to Mubarak on his European tour: the north of Iraq should not be exposed to any power.
- Egypt welcomes the cancellation of the terrorism conference, which was to be held on Sunday in London.
- Egypt urges for the oil-for-food agreement between Iraq and the U.N. to be fulfilled.
- Moussa: we cannot keep silent concerning the creation of a Turkish security zone in north Iraq.
- Mubarak receives a letter from the Zambian President on bilateral relations and African issues.
